primitives.name: Authentication Barrier Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: - Auth: cookie `access_token`; refresh cookie `refresh_token`; token is read via `window.getAccessToken()` and sent as an `Auth` header by the client.
primitives.assumptions: Client-side token management is deterministic and secure.
primitives.breakdown_regime: 401 Unauthorized response upon invalid or missing token.

layer2.mapping: Maps client-side auth cookies to server-side request headers via HTTP standard.
layer2.telemetry: Token validity and refresh cycle success rate.

primitives.name: Prediction Consensus Signal
primitives.verbatim_quote: `agreed_votes_percent` / `all_votes_count` is a crowd-consensus signal, not a model output — treat it as such.
primitives.assumptions: Votes represent independent agent decisions with uniform distribution.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Signal becomes unreliable when vote count < 10.

layer2.mapping: Aggregates individual predictions into a collective confidence measure.
layer2.telemetry: Consensus strength over time for each match prediction.

primitives.name: Match Audit Field Set
primitives.verbatim_quote: Match record fields that matter to the audit: **`referees`**, `broadcasts`, `has_squads`, `has_standings`, `has_h2h`, `has_statistic`, `expected_prediction`, `created_at`.
primitives.assumptions: All fields are present and correctly populated in audit context.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Missing or malformed field triggers data integrity alert.

layer2.mapping: Maps structured match metadata to audit compliance criteria.
